title: Kissed Turkish Lettuce Casserole
description: A yeasty, snappy, nostalgic Turkish casserole featuring tender baby lettuce leaves wrapped in a light yeast dough and finished in a gentle bain-marie, sugar-free and comforting.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180C and place a shallow pan of water in the bottom to create a bain-marie.
In a small bowl, combine 60ml warm water and 3g instant yeast; let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
In a mixing bowl, whisk together 120g flour, 5g salt, 15ml olive oil, the foamy yeast mixture, and 200g Greek yogurt until a smooth dough forms.
Roll the dough into a thin sheet, then cut it into squares that will cover the baby lettuce leaves.
Place each lettuce leaf on a dough square, fold the edges over the leaf, and seal with a pinch of salt.
Arrange the wrapped lettuce pieces in a greased baking dish, leaving a small gap between each.
In a separate bowl, whisk 5g lemon zest, 5g dill, 2g cumin, 1g oregano, 1g chili flakes, and 20g walnuts; sprinkle over the casserole.
Cover the dish with foil and bake in the bain-marie for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil, bake an additional 5 minutes until the dough edges turn golden.
Let the casserole rest 5 minutes before serving, spooning any leftover sauce over the top.
